notes.title: Update Announcement for Just a Lullaby
notes.content:
Dear players,
We are pleased to announce the release of a new update for Just a Lullaby. This update introduces several changes and improvements to the game. Below you will find a detailed list of the new features:
Main Changes

Complete update of gamepad functionality

Improvements

Various graphical fixes

Thank you for your continued support, and enjoy playing Just a Lullaby!
The Development Team  :)
